facts.about: KPIT is a global technology company with software solutions that will help mobility leapfrog towards autonomous, clean, smart and connected future. With 13000+ Automobelievers across the globe, specializing in embedded software, AI & Digital solutions, KPIT enables customers accelerate implementation of next generation mobility technologies . With development centers in Europe, USA, Japan, China, Thailand and India

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 165% of PAT
Latest quarter growth (+6%) well below 3-yr trend (+24%)

business.summary: KPIT Technologies Ltd. provides embedded software and integration solutions for the automotive and mobility ecosystem, helping clients make software-defined vehicles a reality and generating revenue through engineering services, solutions, products, and licensing.

guidance.statement: H2 will be better than H1.
guidance.quote: So, I think we have mentioned last time that H2 will be better than H1. I think we will maintain that.

guidance.statement: H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4
guidance.quote: During the outlook, we have just mentioned that H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4, driven by the Q4 performance

guidance.statement: Medium-term outlook remains good, expecting to achieve 22% to 24% by FY '29
guidance.quote: During the Analyst Day, you spoke about an aspiration of achieving 22% to 24% by FY '29. That aspiration can still hold? Or would you worry about it at the moment? Kishor Patil: I would say the medium-term outlook remains good

guidance.statement: Q4 revenue growth will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
guidance.quote: One is, we believe that in the last quarter that is Q4, we will improve, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.

guidance.statement: Profitability will improve in Q4 compared to Q3 despite investments.
guidance.quote: And our profitability will improve from what we have in Q3 in spite of our investments.

guidance.statement: The company will grow next year at a higher rate than this year.
guidance.quote: The second thing is we feel reasonably, I mean, and please recognize that we will tell you at end of Q4, but I am just giving you my feel right now. We will for sure grow next year higher than this year.

scorecard.promised: Highest quarterly growth in FY26 during Q4 FY26.
scorecard.delivered: Delivered highest quarterly revenue of ₹1,711 cr (+5.8% QoQ) in Mar 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Mar 2026 revenue of ₹1,711 cr was higher than Dec 2025 (₹1,617 cr), Sep 2025 (₹1,588 cr), and Jun 2025 (₹1,539 cr).

scorecard.promised: Profitability will improve in Q4 compared to Q3 despite investments.
scorecard.delivered: Operating margin declined to 18% in Mar 2026 from 19% in Dec 2025.
scorecard.evidence: Operating margin fell from 19% in Q3 FY26 (Dec 2025) to 18% in Q4 FY26 (Mar 2026).

scorecard.promised: Company will grow next year (FY27) at a higher rate than this year (FY26).
scorecard.delivered: Q1 FY27 YoY growth fell to 8.8% and Q2 FY27 YoY growth fell to 6.5%.
scorecard.evidence: FY26 overall growth was 10.5% (₹6,455 cr vs ₹5,842 cr), whereas Q1/Q2 FY27 run-rate dropped to 8.8% and 6.5%.

scorecard.promised: H2 FY27 will be better than H1 FY27, returning to growth by Q4 FY27.
scorecard.delivered: H1 FY27 total revenue stands at ₹3,366 cr (Q1 ₹1,675 cr + Q2 ₹1,691 cr).
scorecard.evidence: H2 FY27 needs over ₹3,366 cr (run-rate >₹1,683 cr per quarter) to beat H1 FY27.

scorecard.promised: Achieve 22% to 24% EBITDA margin by FY29.
scorecard.delivered: Margin dropped to 15% in Q1 FY27 and 16% in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: Operating margins stand at 16% in Sep 2026, requiring a 600-800 bps expansion by FY29.

narrative.scoreline: Management has consistently missed near-term profitability commitments and faced growth deceleration, leaving ambitious medium-term targets reliant on steep back-ended recoveries.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Fixed price revenue mix increased, helping productivity and business mix.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margin dropped from 21% in Dec 2024 to 16% in Sep 2026 despite fixed price mix reaching 70%.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Q1 FY27 faced disproportionate profitability impact dropping revenue by 5% QoQ.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue dropped 2.1% QoQ (₹1,711 cr to ₹1,675 cr) in Jun 2026, while margin compressed 300 bps QoQ from 18% to 15%.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Q2 FY27 overall YoY growth was 6.5% and 1% QoQ in rupee terms.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Sep 2026 revenue of ₹1,691 cr grew 6.5% YoY (vs ₹1,588 cr) and 0.95% QoQ (vs ₹1,675 cr).

bull: Strong cumulative cash generation with 5-year operating cash flow reaching 165% of net profit.
Fixed-price contract mix increased to 70%, establishing higher platform and product capability differentiation.
Clean balance sheet supported by low debt/equity of 0.21x and ₹3,687 cr in net worth.
bear: YoY revenue growth slowed sharply to 6.5% in Sep 2026 from 22.7% in Sep 2024.
Operating margins compressed from 21% in Mar 2025 to 16% in Sep 2026.
Customer concentration risk materialized as top two accounts reduced revenue by 13% due to project cancellations.
watch: Q3 FY27 revenue run-rate to confirm if H2 FY27 will exceed H1 FY27 ₹3,366 cr base.

claims.claim: Overall growth was 6.5% year-on-year and 1% sequentially in rupee terms.
claims.quote: So, overall growth has been 6.5% year-on-year and 1%, in terms of quarter-on-quarter, in rupee terms.

claims.claim: EBITDA margin rose 60 basis points to 17.8% driven by higher product contributions.
claims.quote: In terms of profitability, our EBITDA has grown from 17.2% to 17.8%, this is 60 basis point, largely it is because of the business mix as the products contributions are higher as compared to the services part

claims.claim: Two top accounts impacted revenue by 13% due to program cancellations.
claims.quote: we had an impact due to a sharp decline we had due to cancellation of their programs or cutting off their expense was 13% of the total revenue.

claims.claim: About 9% of revenues come from AI first projects with over 9,000 platform users.
claims.quote: Roughly around 9% of revenues come from what we call AI first projects.

claims.claim: Fixed price projects increased to about 70%, helping productivity and differentiation.
claims.quote: The fixed price projects have moved to about 70%, which is significant.

claims.claim: Q1 had a degrowth of 1% YoY, 5% QoQ drop in revenue, and disproportionate impact on profitability due to forex and Qorix loss.
claims.quote: specifically for the quarter 1, we talked about that year-on-year, it would have a degrowth of about 1% resulting in a quarter-on-quarter drop of about 5% in terms of revenue and more than disproportionate impact on profitability.

claims.claim: KPIT secured USD 257 million worth of deal wins during the quarter, mainly driven by connected cars, after-sales transformation, and autonomous.
claims.quote: On the back of that, what was still good was KPIT could do USD 257 million worth wins during the quarter, which was across the world, but mainly driven through connected cars, then after sales transformation and autonomous.

claims.claim: Commercial vehicles will return to growth next quarter after a temporary drop due to a high base in the previous quarter.
claims.quote: On the commercial vehicle, we will be on for growth next quarter. Actually, this quarter also, there was one specific thing what has happened was a quarter before we had one significant revenue in a particular place.

claims.claim: Moving to solution-based transformation to address OEMs changing business challenges ahead of time.
claims.quote: That is why we are moving to solutions-based transformation.

claims.claim: Fixed price revenue mix increased to 66% compared to 59% last year.
claims.quote: Now, there are a couple of indications there. The fixed price revenue mix in our business is 66% against 59% last year.

claims.claim: Invested USD 3.8 million in the business during the quarter, excluding AI investments.
claims.quote: We have continued the investment in this business, which is about USD 3.8 million during the quarter. This does not include the AI investments we are making, which is in addition to this.

risks.text: Mobility industry disruption and passenger car segment revenue concentration impacts growth and profitability.
Technology disruptions from emerging technologies like AI can impact the business model.
Top talent attraction and retention challenges due to growing Global Capability Centers.
Inability to grow in key clients and revenue concentration can impact business growth.
Major currency fluctuations can have an impact on company financial results.
